description: Ministry of Power and Energy - Revise the Fuel price to be Effective from 12.00 Midnight on March 31st of 2024
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Power and Energy using statutory authority under the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act to issue a regulatory order revising fuel prices. It focuses on legal/regulatory action (price regulation under existing legislation) rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The mention of the minister's name is incidental to the regulatory function being exercised.
